publicationStmt.p: Research draft. Final publication requires the notebook's completeness gate.

encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: μάστιγα δ’ ἐν χεροῖν ἔχων ἐτεύτασεν.

div.note: Photius τευτάζειν· πραγματεύεσθαι ἢ σκευωρεῖσθαι ἢ στραγγεύεσθαι καὶ πολὺ διατρίβειν ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ . . . Φρύνιχος Μύσταις κτλ. χεροῖν Ruhnken. Tim. 254] χερσίν. ἐτεύτασεν Bergk. R. c. Att. 375] τευτασθαι (sic). τευτάζεται Ruhnken. at media forma inusitata comicis. flagello sine dubio is de quo narratur ad coercendos servos utebatur. cf. Aristoph. Eq. 59. 64. 67.

lg.l: ἐβουλόμην ἂν ἡμιν ὥσπερ καὶ προτοῦ

div.note: Eustathius 1112, 36 Ἴωνες δὲ πολλάκις δὲ καὶ Ἀθηναῖοι προπερισπῶσι (τὸ ἡμῖν) ἐν συστολῇ τοῦ ῑ . . . Φρύνιχος Μύστῃ κτλ. at cum eius quam Eustathius commemorat consuetudinis apud tragicos quidem permulta, apud comicos certa exempla nulla exstent (cf. quae adnotavimus ad Aristoph. Av. 386), scribendum videtur ἐβουλόμην ἂν νὴ Δί’ ὥσπερ κτλ.
Ad Mystas Bergkius R. c. Att. 375 adsentiente Meinekio refert fr. 70.
